description: The CAREGIVERS table contains information about individual caregivers. Each row represents a unique caregiver (CGID) and includes a label potentially categorizing the caregiver, as well as a description of their job title or role. The ROW_ID serves as the unique identifier for each record in the table.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Categorical label or code assigned to the caregiver.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The job title or role of the caregiver.
